arguments.sql: SELECT CASE strftime('%w', date) WHEN '0' THEN 'Sunday' WHEN '1' THEN 'Monday' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thursday' WHEN '5' THEN 'Friday' WHEN '6' THEN 'Saturday' END AS day_of_week, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions GROUP BY strftime('%w', date) ORDER BY strftime('%w', date)
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions for each day of the week, listed Sunday first through Saturday.
assumptions: Counts every row in the transactions table, including those with no fraud label, since the question does not mention fraud.
Day of week is taken from the transaction date, covering 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
Negative-amount transactions are included as they are transactions too.
